rationale: With only 13 minutes to close, the last five 1-minute candles show extremely tight, nearly flat price action clustered at $31.17 with minimal range (except the final candle's spike to $31.34 which has already partially reversed), suggesting no sustained directional momentum. The ATR is very small ($0.068) relative to the spread and execution risk at end of day, and any position would be forcibly liquidated at market close, making the risk/reward unfavorable. Given today's already negative P&L and the lack of a clear directional catalyst, skipping is the prudent choice.
